resolutions.answer: Exactly two probe-exercised behaviors are determined differently by format.md and reference.py: (1) pair ordering — format.md mandates mapping (insertion) order, reference.py emits sorted key order, divergent on probes 1, 5, 6; (2) backslash handling — format.md's escaping clause is exhaustive over ';' and '=' so a literal backslash passes through verbatim, while reference.py doubles it, divergent on probe 4. Every other behavior exercised by the probe set (key=value pair rendering; '=' escaping; ';' escaping including trailing ';'; empty key and empty value rendering; empty mapping as the empty string) is determined identically, argued clause-by-clause in ea-behavior-statement.md. E-A's coverage condition is met by explicit enumeration of the behaviors each probe exercises.
